description: This file contains internal memory management utilities for Abseil container implementations, including aligned memory allocation, object construction, and layout compatibility checks.

classes.name: AlignedType
classes.description: A struct with specified alignment used for aligned memory allocations.

classes.name: OffsetOf
classes.description: Template to determine the offset of members in a pair-like structure, avoiding non-portable offsetof on non-standard-layout types.

classes.name: IsLayoutCompatible
classes.description: Checks if two types (e.g., pair types) are layout-compatible, ensuring safe union storage and reinterpretation.

classes.name: map_slot_type
classes.description: Union representing a map slot with const and mutable pair types, ensuring layout compatibility and safe access.

classes.name: map_slot_policy
classes.description: Provides static methods for constructing, destroying, and transferring map slot objects, handling layout compatibility and key mutability.

methods.name: Allocate
methods.description: Allocates at least n bytes aligned to a specified power-of-two alignment using a given allocator.

methods.name: Deallocate
methods.description: Deallocates memory previously allocated with Allocate, respecting alignment.

methods.name: ConstructFromTuple
methods.description: Constructs an object of type T in uninitialized storage using arguments from a tuple.

methods.name: WithConstructed
methods.description: Constructs an object of type T from a tuple and applies a function to it.

methods.name: PairArgs
methods.description: Creates pairs of tuples with references to constructor arguments for std::pair.

methods.name: DecomposePair
methods.description: Decomposes a pair of arguments for use in map policies.

methods.name: DecomposeValue
methods.description: Decomposes a value for use in set policies.

methods.name: SanitizerPoisonMemoryRegion
methods.description: Poisons a memory region for sanitizers.

methods.name: SanitizerUnpoisonMemoryRegion
methods.description: Unpoisons a memory region for sanitizers.
